headline: Grain elevator fire on Marginal Road is out. Cause under investigation
dek: The city says this is the final update on the Oct. 26 fire at the Halifax Grain Elevator.

facts.v: Declared under control at approximately 10:40 p.m., Monday, Oct. 26
Halifax Grain Elevator property, 730 Marginal Road
Approximately 20 firefighting, command, safety and support fire apparatus at the height of the response

body: The fire at the Halifax Grain Elevator property at 730 Marginal Road was declared under control at approximately 10:40 p.m. on Monday, Oct. 26, and crews have since left the scene.

Halifax Regional Fire & Emergency responded at approximately 7:15 p.m. after a report of visible flames. The fire was contained to the south conveyor system's dust handling equipment and associated hopper infrastructure, and it did not spread to surrounding structures.
The scene was secured and turned over for investigation. The origin and cause of the fire are under investigation.
